decisionsTitle: The team's undertaking at sign-in: «Angajament de confidențialitate și protecția datelor pentru echipă», a ninth legal text, accepted once per account and version before the backoffice opens to anyone below the Administrator
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-19:** «Voluntarii trebuie să semneze acordul GDPR când intră în platformă» (the volunteers must sign the GDPR agreement when they enter the platform). Asked, the owner chose once per account — and once more for every new version the club approves —, not at every sign-in.

**What was there.** The volunteer agreement (§758) binds an event's volunteer for one event and one role, its confidentiality clause written for the desk; nothing bound a backoffice account, though every role from the volunteer up sees some of the participants', volunteers' or members' data (§289, §754). Section 12 of the privacy notice says what the club keeps of its team. `requireStaff` is the one line every backoffice page, Server Action and route handler asks before anything else (§524).

**Decision.**

- **A ninth legal text, `STAFF_DATA_AGREEMENT`** — «Angajament de confidențialitate și protecția datelor pentru echipă» / “Team confidentiality and data protection undertaking” —, last in the enum and in `LEGAL_DOCUMENT_KEYS`, in a group of its own on `/admin/legal` («Angajamentul echipei», id `team`), its code `TEAM`. The platform's template in Romanian and English (`templates/team-agreement.ts`, ten sections, the house's legal style, the lawyer's questions at its top): the club by its four facts as visible `<PLACEHOLDER>`s and the team member by the name typed at the acceptance, no merge field; acting only under the club's authority and on its instructions (GDPR art. 29 and 32(4)); the participants', volunteers' and members' data used only for the role's tasks and only as far as they need; kept confidential during and after the role, without a time limit, and disclosed to nobody outside the team; no copies, exports, photographs, screenshots or recordings beyond what the task needs, a file kept on a locked device and deleted after, nothing sent outside the team; a printed list kept on them or in a supervised place on race day, handed back or destroyed after; the account personal and the session never left open unattended; a lost or stolen phone, a wrong recipient, a lost list or any incident told to the club at once at its contact address, the club deciding what follows (art. 33, 34); access withdrawn when the role ends or the undertaking is broken; what the club keeps of the colleague and of the acceptance, pointing to the privacy notice; the law and the courts. Neither a contract of employment nor a volunteering contract, and not the volunteer agreement. An agent drafted it; the club approves it in `/admin/legal` like every text — «start from the platform's text», «Regenerează din șablon», «Regenerează din șabloane (N din 9)».
- **Approved on its own, never by the one press.** `PLATFORM_APPROVAL_KEYS` («Aprobă acum textele care lipsesc…», §132, §515) leaves it out: from the moment a version is in force, every colleague below the Administrator is stopped at their next request until they accept it — on race day, the whole desk —, so it is read and pressed for itself, never as a side effect of the participants' texts. The page's intro counts every text of the catalogue (nine); the press still counts its own.
- **Never seeded** (`NEVER_SEEDED_KEYS` in `src/db/seeds/sample-legal-documents.ts`): `yarn db:seed`, `yarn db:seed:legal`, the cloud session's setup and the end-to-end databases carry no version of it, so every existing sign-in below the Administrator lands where it always did; the gate's own tests approve one themselves.
- **Who is asked: `mustAcceptTeamAgreement`** in `roles.ts` — the Voluntar, the Redactor, the Organizator and the Tehnic; never the Administrator or the Superadministrator, who run the club and approve the text; a member is no staff at all (§524).
- **The gate, in `requireStaff`** (and so `requireStaffCapability`): while an approved version of `STAFF_DATA_AGREEMENT` is in force — approved, not withdrawn, `effective_at` passed — and the account has not accepted *that* version, a page being drawn (the proxy's `x-br-path`, no `next-action` header) is sent to `/admin/acord?returnTo=<the page>` — a same-site path only, the router's `_rsc` dropped, never the undertaking itself, in the page's own language —, and a Server Action or a route handler (the proxy does not run on `/api`) is refused with `FORBIDDEN`, its message saying to accept the undertaking on `/admin/acord` first; nothing it carried is done. The staff preview of a draft asks the same through `assertTeamAgreementAccepted`. **A layout never redirects for it**: the admin and `/devs` layouts only ask `teamAgreementOwedFor`, to draw the shell bare. The first end-to-end run showed why: the dev sign-in's redirect into the backoffice is drawn for the client router, which kept the layout's redirect to `/admin/acord` with the layout and replayed it on `/admin/acord` itself — requests without end and a page that never showed; a navigation from the public site into the backoffice did the same. Telling a page drawn for the router from a whole document is no way out: Next hides its router headers from a layout's `headers()` and strips them before the proxy runs. The page under the layout sends the reader through its own `requireStaff`, a page being fetched afresh on every navigation; every backoffice page but `/admin/acord` asks it. While the undertaking is owed the layouts draw the shell bare: the title, who is signed in and «Ieși din cont», no tabs and no counts. Exempt: the undertaking's page and its action (`requireStaffBeforeTeamAgreement`) and sign-out, which asks nothing. **No version in force, no gate**: a text the club has not approved binds nobody. A new version in force is asked once more of everybody below the Administrator.
- **`/admin/acord`**: the text in force in the page's language as the legal pages draw it, its version line, «Numele tău complet» (required, 1–200 characters, its spaces collapsed), «Am citit și accept angajamentul» (required) and «Accept și intru»; then back to `returnTo`, else the backoffice's first page, with the toast «Gata: angajamentul e acceptat.». A colleague who owes nothing — an Administrator, nothing in force, the version accepted — is sent straight on: it is never a second way to read or accept a text. 44-pixel targets, no sideways scroll at 320 px.
- **The acceptance, once per account and version** — `staff_team_agreement_acceptances`, migration `0221_staff_team_agreement` (expand only, generated by drizzle-kit: the enum value and the table, which never names the value, so nothing uses it in the transaction that adds it): the version (`legal_document_id`, `RESTRICT`, and its number), the version's own hash (`content_sha256`), the language, the name typed, the SHA-256 of the exact text read in that language (`signedTextHash`, §556), the moment, and the IP address and browser of the press (§771) — the declarations' proof; `UNIQUE (staff_user_id, legal_document_id)`, so a second press, a double tap, writes nothing; `ON DELETE CASCADE` with the account, so «Retrage accesul» takes the acceptance with it and switching the account off keeps both. Audited `staff.team_agreement_accepted` — the version, the language and the acceptance's id, never the name typed. Refused with nothing written: an empty or over-long name, a missing tick, a version replaced while the page was open (`CONFLICT`). Each acceptance is one more reliance on its version on `/admin/legal` (`acceptanceCount`): it is retired, never deleted, under them (§567).
- **«Echipa»** draws, for the Administrators who read it, a line on every row: «Angajamentul echipei: Acceptat — versiunea N, <data>, ca „<numele scris>”» for the version in force the colleague accepted (while none is in force, the newest they ever accepted), «Neacceptat», or «Nu e cerut» for a role that is not asked — words, never a chip.
- **«Sarcini»** carries the club's row «Angajamentul echipei» (`teamAgreement`, a text): open while no version is in force — the team works with the participants' data having undertaken nothing —, done by itself the day one takes effect; always on the list, never blocking.
- **The guide**: «Primii pași» → «Angajamentul echipei, la prima intrare» (what a new colleague sees at the first sign-in), the legal section → «Aprobă angajamentul echipei», and one more step under «Conturi pentru voluntari și colegi». `SETUP.md` §48 holds the club's steps — a lawyer first, approved at least a day before the race, never on its morning —, §34 a sentence, `docs/OWNER-TODO.md` item 26.

**Refused, and why.**

- Asking at every sign-in, a PDF of the acceptance, the members' zone: not in this change (the owner chose once per account).
- Hiding the backoffice or a button for a colleague who owes the undertaking: the gate is the server's (BR-REQ-060-01); the bare shell is a courtesy on the one page they may open.
- Redirecting a Server Action instead of refusing it: an action is refused with `FORBIDDEN` as the brief asks; the house's actions answer a refusal by going back to their page, whose own `requireStaff` then sends the reader to the undertaking.
- A sample in the seed, or the undertaking in the one press: either would put it in force by a side effect — on every test database, or on the club's own production by a press about other texts.
- A paper road: a sign-in is electronic, so the trace is always kept.
- Keeping an acceptance after its account is removed, and naming the acceptance in the privacy notice's section 12 (which already covers «who did what on the platform»): both are the lawyer's and the owner's to decide; no template of another text was edited.
- One status for every admin route: each route keeps its own mapping of `requireStaff`'s refusal (most answer 401 with `{ "error": "FORBIDDEN" }`); forty files were not rewritten for a status code.

**For the lawyer, not decided here.** Whether an undertaking accepted electronically at sign-in is the right instrument under art. 29 and 32(4), or a signed confidentiality agreement or an annex to the volunteer contract is wanted as well; confidentiality «fără limită de timp»; the sentence on liability; a colleague under eighteen with an account; how long the acceptance is kept once the account is removed; whether the IP address and the browser are needed for a colleague signed in to their own account.
changelogLine: - **The team's undertaking at sign-in** — a ninth legal text, «Angajament de confidențialitate și protecția datelor pentru echipă», which the club approves on its own in «Documente legale» (never by «Aprobă acum textele care lipsesc…», never by the seed); once a version is in force, every Voluntar, Redactor, Organizator and Tehnic reads it on `/admin/acord`, types their full name, ticks «Am citit și accept angajamentul» and presses «Accept și intru» before any backoffice page, press or file answers them — then lands where they were going, a scanned race number included; a new version is asked once more, Administrators never; «Echipa» says who accepted which version, when and as whom, and «Sarcini» asks the club to approve the text. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the legal document key `STAFF_DATA_AGREEMENT` («Angajament de confidențialitate și protecția datelor pentru echipă» / “Team confidentiality and data protection undertaking”, appended last to the enum by migration `0221_staff_team_agreement`, which writes no text), then the platform ships its template in Romanian and English — ten sections, the same paragraphs in both: the club and the team member; acting only under the club's authority and on its instructions (GDPR art. 29 and 32(4)); the participants', volunteers' and members' data used only for the role's tasks; confidential during and after the role; no copies, exports, photographs or screenshots beyond the task and nothing sent outside the team; printed lists kept safe on race day and handed back or destroyed after; the account personal and the session never left open unattended; a lost phone, a wrong recipient or any incident told to the club at once at its contact address; access withdrawn when the role ends or the undertaking is broken; the team member's data, the acceptance and the law — neither a contract of employment nor a volunteering contract, with the club's four facts as visible `<PLACEHOLDER>`s, no merge field and no club, place, date or amount written in; it has a group of its own («Angajamentul echipei») and the code `TEAM`, and no seed writes it on any environment (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the team's undertaking on `/admin/legal`, then an Administrator starts it from the platform's text and regenerates it like every text («Regenerează din șabloane (N din 9)», the catalogue's nine), approves it only on its own — «Aprobă acum textele care lipsesc…» (`PLATFORM_APPROVAL_KEYS`) leaves it out, so approving the participants' texts never puts it in force —, «Șabloanele textelor legale s-au schimbat» names it to the lawyer as itself, and every acceptance of a version counts as a reliance on it (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an approved version of `STAFF_DATA_AGREEMENT` in force, when a Voluntar, a Redactor, an Organizer or a Tehnic (`mustAcceptTeamAgreement`) who has not accepted that version reaches the backoffice, then every backoffice page — a scanned number, the guide, `/devs`, a staff preview — sends them to `/admin/acord` with the page they asked for as `returnTo` (a same-site path only, the router's `_rsc` dropped, never the undertaking itself), the admin and `/devs` layouts meanwhile drawing the shell bare and never redirecting themselves, so a navigation into the backoffice from the sign-in or the public site lands on the undertaking instead of looping, and every Server Action and admin route handler refuses with `FORBIDDEN`, saying to accept the undertaking, with nothing written — asserted in `requireStaff`, the one line every backoffice request asks, never by hiding a control; the undertaking's page, its action and sign-out stay open to them; the Administrator and the Superadministrator are never asked and a member stays no staff; with no approved version in force — none, a draft, one withdrawn, one dated ahead — nobody is asked; and a newly approved version is asked once more (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given `/admin/acord` for a colleague who owes the undertaking, then it shows the text in force in the page's language with its version line, «Numele tău complet» (required, 1–200 characters once trimmed), «Am citit și accept angajamentul» (required) and «Accept și intru», under the backoffice's title and «Ieși din cont» with no tabs, its targets 44 pixels and no sideways scroll at 320 px; a press stores one acceptance per account and version — the version and its own hash, the language, the name typed, the SHA-256 of the exact text read, the moment, the IP address and the browser — audited `staff.team_agreement_accepted` with the version and never the name, and goes back to `returnTo`, else `/admin`; a second press writes nothing; an empty or over-long name, a missing tick or a version replaced since the page was drawn is refused with nothing written; and a colleague who owes nothing is sent straight on (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Echipa» read by an Administrator, then every row says in words «Angajamentul echipei: Acceptat — versiunea N, <data>, ca „<numele scris>”» for the version in force the colleague accepted (or, while none is in force, the newest they accepted), «Neacceptat», or «Nu e cerut» for a role that is not asked; and «Sarcini» carries the club's row «Angajamentul echipei», open while no version is in force and done once one is, never blocking (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the team's undertaking at sign-in — a ninth legal text the club approves on its own, accepted on /admin/acord once per version by every colleague below the Administrator
